app_info.subtitle: Read short fiction in ChatGPT
app_info.description: FICTURN lets users browse and read short, finished fiction directly inside ChatGPT. The current library includes romantic suspense, uncanny horror, and near-future speculative fiction, presented in an inline reader with progress, Previous and Continue navigation, and a Library view. FICTURN serves fixed story text and does not generate or rewrite the prose on the fly.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns metadata for the fixed FICTURN catalog and does not modify data or state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content, contact third parties, or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves part one of a selected fixed story and returns it to the reader.

test_cases.description: Browse the available FICTURN story catalog.
test_cases.expected_output: Displays the FICTURN library with the three available stories, including their title, genre, hook, tags, mood, and reading time.

test_cases.description: Start the romantic suspense story from a genre request.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a short romantic suspense story.
test_cases.expected_output: Opens The Safehouse Rule at part 1 in the inline FICTURN reader.

test_cases.description: Start the uncanny horror story from a duration and mood request.
test_cases.user_prompt: I want an eerie five-minute story.
test_cases.expected_output: Opens Room 713 at part 1 in the inline FICTURN reader.
Opens The Last Reply at part 1 in the inline FICTURN reader.

test_cases.description: Continue an already-open story to its exact next fragment.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the exact next fixed fragment of the story already being read, without rewriting, skipping, or improvising prose.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use FICTURN to generate an open-ended sequel.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a new sequel to Room 713 and keep it going forever.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: FICTURN should not be invoked to generate new prose because it only serves fixed, finished stories.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use FICTURN to rewrite a canonical ending.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Change the ending of The Last Reply so everyone survives.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: FICTURN should not be invoked to rewrite or mutate its fixed story text.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke FICTURN for an unrelated communication task.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to my manager about tomorrow's meeting.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: FICTURN should not be invoked because email and external communication are outside its fiction-reading workflows.
